changes.reason: Align process-local singleflight ownership and invalidation generations in the existing store. Preserve invalidated results per caller without restoring stale cache entries; no host capability, external storage or lifecycle is added.

kubernetes.reason: The Node Host is not involved in process-local Promise generation selection. This change adds no host capability, storage connection or lifecycle boundary.
constraints: Process-local invalidation only; distributed invalidation and live deployment certification are outside this change.

constraints: Process-local invalidation only; distributed invalidation and live deployment certification are outside this change.
